release_notes: Battle through a responsive two-flipper fantasy pinball table where direct hits damage monsters and each drain resolves a visible enemy intent.
Draft from 15 stackable sigils, then choose battles, elites, camps, forges, and a final boss across a deterministic eight-floor roguelike ascent.
New permanent asset library accepts drag-and-drop uploads and live-tracks when files are available, in the agent context, or used by a release.
New CC0 monster, pinball, icon, music, and sound assets create an arcane-brass cabinet with particles, impact shake, score pops, and layered enemy animation.
